answer: The ripple schedule is applied in garden and ocean shows each instalment. A payout is split and hence 58% arrives at settlement and the rest over 8 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4796 identities would post 637 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
